.. change::
    :tags: bug, orm, regression
    :tickets: 13818

    Fixed regression caused by :ticket:`12168` where a collection-based
    :func:`_orm.relationship` using the
    :ref:`orm_declarative_native_dataclasses` feature with
    :paramref:`_orm.relationship.collection_class` set to
    :func:`_orm.ordering_list` would raise an error if
    :paramref:`_orm.relationship.default_factory` were set to the plain
    ``list`` type.  The plain collection type is now resolved from a sample
    instance when the collection factory is a no-argument callable, so
    ``default_factory=list`` is accepted for :func:`_orm.ordering_list`
    as it already was for :func:`_orm.attribute_keyed_dict`.
